Rho enables signed automatic updates for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Updates

- Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, and Linux x86-64 now share the signed
  development updater channel.
- Rho checks for a newer release after local startup becomes ready and installs
  a verified update automatically with transactional recovery.
- The release page includes the Windows installer, macOS disk image, and Linux
  AppImage with exact checksums and updater signatures.

## Windows trust

- Windows development packages use the SignPath Free Trial self-signed test
  certificate. It is not publicly trusted, and Windows or SmartScreen may
  still warn.
